ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.Self)` (Inferno.cs:15-18) == cost 1 / POWER / UNCOMMON / SELF.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<InfernoPower>(..., DynamicVars["InfernoPower"].BaseValue, ...)` followed by `?.IncrementSelfDamage()` on the returned power (Inferno.cs:23) == `PowerCmd.apply(...)` then re-fetch by id and `power.increment_self_damage()` (inferno.py:253-255). On the normal path both reach the same instance and increment it exactly once per play. Presentation, folded in: TriggerAnim (22).

guards.what: C# skips IncrementSelfDamage when Apply returns NULL; the sim increments whenever the power is present (Inferno.cs:23 vs inferno.py:253-255)
guards.issue: Identical to card/crimson_mantle's guard and carrying the same verdict (rule 3): `PowerCmd.Apply<T>` returns null when combat is ending, when `!target.CanReceivePowers`, or when the stacking `ModifyAmount` resolves to 0 (PowerCmd.cs:29-34, 68-87), and the null-conditional `?.` then skips the increment. The sim's re-fetch by id cannot distinguish those cases, so a second Inferno whose amount was zeroed would still bump the self-damage counter and cost the player an extra HP per turn for the rest of the combat. DORMANT: no ported effect modifies a positive self-applied BUFF down to exactly 0 (Artifact intercepts only debuffs, cmds.py:299-306), and the other two null cases imply the combat is over. These two cards are the only `?.Increment...` sites in the pool.
